name: RamanSTS dataset, a large collection of Raman spectra of soft tissue sarcomas
description: 286,672 ex-vivo Raman spectra (Renishaw inVia, 633 nm, 400-1,800 cm⁻¹, 1,401 points) of surgically resected soft tissue from 7 patients, measured as 51x51 maps over 100 x 100 µm. Target: tissue type (WHO classification), 8 classes: fat, muscle and skin (normal), leiomyoma (benign), myxoid liposarcoma, high-grade pleomorphic liposarcoma, leiomyosarcoma and high-grade myxofibrosarcoma (malignant). Leiomyoma, myxoid liposarcoma, leiomyosarcoma and high-grade myxofibrosarcoma each come from a single patient, so for them grouped splits measure generalisation across regions of one specimen, not across patients. Three maps (P3 muscle, P3 pleomorphic liposarcoma, P4 myxoid liposarcoma) are partial: spectra with artefacts (tissue contamination, ink) were removed in WiRE. Group ids are the 18 patient x tissue files; the map of each spectrum is not published yet.

rai:dataCollection: Point-mapping Raman microscopy of ex-vivo tissue: Renishaw inVia, 633 nm excitation, 51 x 51 grid over 100 x 100 µm, 0.5 s exposure per spot, 400-1,800 cm⁻¹ (1,401 points).
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Renishaw WiRE before export, in this order: fifth-order polynomial baseline correction, median filtering to remove cosmic rays, Savitzky-Golay smoothing (polynomial order 3), min-max normalisation of each spectrum to [0, 1]. Then interpolated onto a 1 cm⁻¹ grid and cropped to 400-1,800 cm⁻¹ in Python (per the dataset authors).
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each specimen was labelled by histopathology (WHO classification of soft tissue tumours); every spectrum of a map carries its specimen's label.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Spectra of human tissue, labelled by diagnosis. The published metadata gives each patient's age, sex and tumour location; the spectra carry pseudonymous patient ids (P1-P7) but no direct identifiers.
rai:dataBiases: 7 patients, one hospital, one instrument. Four classes (leiomyoma, myxoid liposarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, high-grade myxofibrosarcoma) come from a single patient each, and class sizes range from 10,404 to 83,742 spectra.
rai:dataLimitations: For the four single-patient classes, grouped splits over maps measure generalisation across regions of one specimen, not across patients. Three maps (P3 muscle, P3 pleomorphic liposarcoma, P4 myxoid liposarcoma) are partial: spectra with artefacts (tissue contamination, ink) were removed. Spectra are already baseline-corrected, smoothed and normalised, so further preprocessing must not repeat these steps. Licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial).
rai:dataSocialImpact: Supports research on intraoperative margin assessment for soft tissue sarcoma surgery. Not validated for clinical use; results must be confirmed by histopathology.
rai:dataUseCases: Tissue-type classification, tumour vs normal tissue discrimination, sarcoma subtyping.
